title: dep-scan triage output
description: The document a depscan triage subcommand writes on stdout in json format: what the command did to the decisions file, or the listing it printed. A refused command produces the error document instead of this one, with exit 2; the check subcommand exits 3 when the file carries errors a gate would hit, with the errors in this document.

decisionsFile.description: The decisions file the command read or wrote, as its path was given or the default it resolved to.

subcommand.description: Which triage subcommand produced the document.

result.description: What the set, review and remove subcommands did.

entry.description: The entry the command wrote, approved, rejected or removed, as it now stands.

replaced.description: The decision an approval replaced: the review subcommand's approval of a proposal removes the decision with the same selector, because the approver has decided the finding. Absent when the approval replaced none.

entries.description: The entries the list and check subcommands printed, in file order; the review subcommand lists the proposals only, and its handle lists count those.

stale.description: The handles of the entries that matched no finding in the scan directory.

shadowed.description: The handles of the entries that match findings in the scan directory, every one of which another entry decides, so they change nothing.

expired.description: The handles of the entries past their expiry.

proposals.description: The handles of the entries waiting for a person to approve them.

scanDir.description: The scan directory the entries were matched against, when one was given.

valid.description: The check subcommand's verdict: whether the file loads and satisfies its schema, so a gate can read it.

errors.description: The check subcommand's refusals, each naming the key, the line and the valid values, the way a scan refuses the file.

index.description: The entry's 1-based position among the triage decisions.

handle.description: The entry's stable handle, which depscan triage review and remove take: tr- and the first ten hex digits of the SHA-256 of its canonical selector, with proposed_by for a proposal.

finding.description: The dsf1 fingerprint the entry selects, when it selects by finding.

advisory.description: The advisory id or alias the entry selects, when it selects by advisory.

versionRange.description: The vers range narrowing the purl selection.

detail.description: The free-form detail about the decision.

proposedBy.description: Who or what proposed the decision.

created.description: When the decision was recorded, as an RFC 3339 date-time.

expires.description: When the decision expires, as an RFC 3339 date-time.

status.description: The computed state of the entry: live applies, a proposal waits for a person, an expired entry suppresses nothing, a stale entry matched no finding in the scan, and a shadowed entry matches findings another entry decides, so it changes nothing.

source.description: Where the entry came from: the decisions file, or the VEX document it was loaded from.

matches.description: The findings the entry matches in the scan directory, when one was given.
